messages:
Evelyn: Quick note  Omar submitted his resignation, last day Thu 2026-07-23. Hes international (visa sponsorship) and has a company laptop + external vendor API creds. Need an offboard checklist that covers visa notices, benefits, and vendor access.
Omar: I can finish the vendor handoff and upload the runbook by Tue. Please don't cut VPN until after the handoff call.
IT-ops: Proposed minimal-impact timeline:
- 09:00 final day: set Slack to Away
- 12:00 final day: make repos read-only and revoke CI deploy tokens
- 16:00 final day: disable Okta and VPN
- 16:05 final day: rotate vendor API keys and revoke external app grants
Commands I'll run (audit attached to JIRA):
```
oktactl deactivate-user --user omar
vault kv delete secret/vendors/acme/omar
gh api --method PATCH /repos/org/project/branches/protect -f protection_level=read-only
```
Security: Take snapshot of active sessions + export auth logs for last 60 days before rotations. If any shared service accounts reference Omar, rotate immediately and note in ticket.
Payroll: Benefits note  COBRA packet will be emailed 2026-07-24; benefits end date in system 2026-08-06. Final pay & PTO payout scheduled 2026-07-30. For visa: People Ops will send termination confirmation that you may need for immigration records.
offboard-bot: Reminder  create JIRA OFFBOARD ticket and attach Notion checklist. Template OFFBOARD-INTL recommended.
Evelyn: I added a calendar hold for handoff Wed 15:00 and linked the drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/omar-handoff.pdf. Omar please confirm laptop return method (courier or drop at HQ).
Omar: I'll drop the laptop at HQ reception Thu morning and uploaded the runbook. I prefer email COBRA packet.
IT-ops: Noted. We'll postpone Okta disable until 16:00 after the 15:00 handoff. Will post rotation logs to JIRA when complete.
Security: Audits queued. Will ACK in thread once export done.
Payroll: Sent COBRA email; final paycheck queued.
Evelyn: Closing loop once IT and Security confirm rotations and Payroll confirms laptop receipt. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
